title: Sheinbaum Touts 1.4% H1 GDP Growth and Tourism Data, Orders Probe of CDMX Police at Oct 2 March
detail: At her Oct 15 conference Sheinbaum said GDP grew 1.4% in the first half, citing construction and AI-driven electronics demand, and that talks with the US remain good despite tariffs because most exports fall under USMCA. Tourism data: 32.7 million international tourists Jan-Aug (+3.9%). The non-resident fee will be 75 pesos, half the initial proposal. She called for investigating CDMX police over alleged abuses at the Oct 2 march, said the CNDH is investigating the repression of Jalisco protesters, discussed a security plan for Cuautla, Morelos after the mayor's arrest, and asked IMSS to improve its wage offer to health workers.
